note: Export side is factually confirmed: dated customs/B-L records with destinations (USA, Italy) and HS codes 73041110 / 73061100 (seamless and welded stainless steel tubes/pipes, grade 316L), BOL numbers 1103731, 9688177, 9466705, 8946940. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search returned a connection error on every attempt, and thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com both returned HTTP 403. Therefore domestic_status = unknown, not 'none_found' — absence of retrieval is not evidence of absence. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in the sources reachable).
